scientific_integrity: An analytic proof establishes the variable-curvature statement using normal-coordinate comparison; numerical space-form integrals are corroboration only. Priority remains subject to independent historical review.
scientific_limitations: The formula is a small-radius population-probability expansion for smooth Riemannian surfaces. There is no exact finite-radius law for variable curvature, no uniform metric-family error bound, and no finite-sample estimator or uncertainty guarantee.
title: Curvature from the acuteness deficit of random geodesic-circle triangles
